nina: quick Q after the all-hands: someone asked if equity cliff changes are happening for new hires. heard a rumor about a 6-month partial vest for new grads. is there truth to this?

omar (People Ops): short answer: no company-wide change like that is happening. current policy remains 1-year cliff then monthly vesting. any pilot for grads would be rolled out with a policy doc and compensation comms.

rachel: thanks Omar. second Q: can you confirm when merit + promo increases appear in ADP? managers are telling ICs "immediately" which is causing confusion.

omar (People Ops): merits/promos post-calibration go into payroll the next run. typical window: 1 payroll cycle (often ~2 weeks). if a promo is approved after the payroll cutoff it shows 2 cycles later. managers should avoid saying "immediate."

ben: edge case: employee on unpaid LOA got a promo. do they keep promo effective date and get retro pay when they return?

omar (People Ops): yes, promo effective date stands. for unpaid LOA, retro pay is handled case-by-case; manager submits the promo packet with LOA notes and selects "retro pay requested" in the HR form. payroll will advise on timing.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: People Ops office hours tomorrow 9:30 AM PT. Add: <https://calendar.redwood.company/peopleops-officehours> :calendar:

nina: awesome, can you share the promo form link and a short FAQ for managers? i'll paste into our team channel.

omar (People Ops): promo form: <https://hr.redwood.company/forms/promo>. manager FAQ: <https://redwood.company/handbook/comp/promo-faq>. i'll post a short blurb in #managers later today.

nina: perfect, thanks!
